    # DEBUG: Export the actual trained HSTU classes and instantiate HSTURec
    # directly. Remove both dynamic importing and the model-class factory so
    # predictor inspection can follow construction to the concrete backbone.
    import ast
    import inspect
    import textwrap

    script = script.replace("import importlib.util\n", "import math\n")
    script = script.replace(
        "import torch\n",
        "import torch\nimport torch.nn as nn\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\n",
    )
    loader_start = script.index("def _load_model_class():")
    loader_end = script.index("def _ensure_loaded()", loader_start)
    backbone_source = "\n\n".join(
        textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(cls)) for cls in (HSTUBlock, HSTURec)
    )
    script = (
        script[:loader_start]
        + backbone_source
        + "\n\n"
        + script[loader_end:]
    )
    factory_assignment = "    model_cls = _load_model_class()\n"
    factory_construction = "        model = model_cls(\n"
    if script.count(factory_assignment) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Generated predictor model factory template changed")
    if script.count(factory_construction) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Generated predictor model construction template changed")
    script = script.replace(factory_assignment, "")
    script = script.replace(
        factory_construction,
        "        model = HSTURec(\n",
    )

    # DEBUG: Check the generated artifact itself, without importing train.py,
    # loading checkpoints, changing RNG states, or constructing another model.
    predictor_path = os.path.join(working_dir, "predict.py")
    tree = ast.parse(script, filename=predictor_path)
    exported_classes = {
        node.name: node
        for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef)
    }
    for cls in (HSTUBlock, HSTURec):
        expected = ast.parse(textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(cls))).body[0]
        actual = exported_classes.get(cls.__name__)
        if actual is None or ast.dump(actual) != ast.dump(expected):
            raise RuntimeError(f"Exported backbone differs from trained {cls.__name__}")
    if "_load_model_class" in script or "importlib" in script:
        raise RuntimeError("Generated predictor still contains dynamic model loading")
    compile(tree, predictor_path, "exec")
    with open(predictor_path, "w") as stream:
        stream.write(script)
